user.title: sanoTTS
user.description: Pick a voice. Named voices download once (2-3 MB) into the Home Assistant cache; after that, synthesis is entirely offline. To stay offline from the start, leave the voice list alone and point the optional directory at an unpacked voice package.

data_description.voice_dir: Absolute path to an unpacked voice package containing manifest.json. When set, nothing is downloaded and this directory is used instead of the selected voice.

error.cannot_download: Could not download the voice. Check that Home Assistant has internet access, or point the integration at a local voice directory instead.
error.cannot_load_voice: Could not load that voice. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.package_missing: The sanotts package is not installed. Restart Home Assistant so it can install the integration's requirements.
error.voice_dir_not_found: That directory does not exist on the Home Assistant host.
